note: Sanctions / country-risk source files for app.ingestion.watchlists. These are ingest-time inputs only: the app reads backend/watchlists_db.sqlite, rebuilt from these files (and this manifest, copied into the provenance table) by `python -m app.ingestion.watchlists.ingest`. Refresh = re-download from source_url, update downloaded/list_date here, then re-run the ingest.

sdn.csv.list: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) List
sdn.csv.format: headerless CSV: ent_num, SDN_Name, SDN_Type, Program, Title, Call_Sign, Vess_type, Tonnage, GRT, Vess_flag, Vess_owner, Remarks; '-0-' denotes null

ConList.csv.list: HM Treasury / OFSI Consolidated List of Financial Sanctions Targets (UK)
ConList.csv.format: line 1 = 'Last Updated,<date>', line 2 = header, name split across 'Name 6' (surname) + 'Name 1..5'

un_consolidated.xml.format: XML, INDIVIDUALS/INDIVIDUAL + ENTITIES/ENTITY; requires a browser User-Agent to download (plain curl gets 404)

fatf_high_risk.json.list: FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions (call for action) + Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring
fatf_high_risk.json.status: authored from the June 2026 FATF statements (fatf-gafi.org blocks automated download; contents cross-checked against multiple secondary trackers on 2026-08-05 - see the note inside the file)
